meme.body_prompt: DURATION: 10 seconds. Image 1 is the first frame: keep exactly this kitchen, this torn-apart roast chicken on the floor, these two dogs and the owner's position. CAMERA: one locked-off static camera on the floor at dog eye level for the entire 10 seconds - no cuts, no zoom, no pan, no shake. Photorealistic, natural daylight, realistic adult Shiba Inu proportions, no clothes, no text. CAST (must stay true for the whole clip): exactly two dogs, both always fully in frame. LEFT = Shiba A, red-orange fox-red coat with cream chest and cheeks. RIGHT = Shiba B, pale cream-white coat, slightly smaller. They never swap sides, never change colour, never leave. The owner (grey sweatshirt, dark joggers, grey socks) stays cropped by the top edge at chest level: his head and face are NEVER visible. ACTION & MOUTH TIMELINE: [0.0-1.5s] owner bends forward and jabs his index finger down at the chicken mess twice; Shiba A sits upright with chin up, mouth closed; Shiba B hunches, head low, ears flat. [1.5-2.6s] owner's hand moves toward the dogs; Shiba A lifts its right front paw and stretches it sideways, the paw tip pointing precisely at Shiba B, and holds the pose. [2.6-2.9s] Shiba A gives one sharp bark (mouth snaps open once) while still pointing. [3.0-4.6s] Shiba A turns its head up toward the owner and barks back three times in quick succession (mouth opens wide at 3.1s, 3.6s, 4.1s), ears forward, defiant; owner's hands lift slightly in surprise. [4.6-6.0s] Shiba A jabs the pointing paw twice toward Shiba B (4.8s, 5.3s) with a short bark on each jab; Shiba B's eyes roll sideways toward Shiba A, head still low. [6.0-7.3s] owner puts his hands on his knees and leans down closer; Shiba A keeps the paw raised, mouth closed, smug. [7.3-8.6s] owner's index finger points straight at Shiba A's raised right front paw, which clearly has glossy chicken grease and a shred of roast chicken meat stuck in the fur; Shiba A freezes, eyes widen. [8.6-10.0s] Shiba A swallows (throat moves once), slowly lowers the paw and tucks it behind its body, and looks away to the side with an awkward guilty face; Shiba B lifts its head and stares flatly at Shiba A. Shiba B's mouth stays closed for the whole clip.
meme.ad_prompt: DURATION: 6 seconds. Image 1 is the first frame: keep exactly these two dogs, the woven rattan basket of golden-brown crumb-coated chicken-drumstick shaped dog treats and the warm kitchen. CAMERA: locked-off, very slow push-in, no cuts. Photorealistic, no text, no people. Shiba A (red-orange) front center, Shiba B (pale cream-white) behind on the right; they never swap or change colour. TIMELINE: [0.0-2.4s] Shiba A looks straight into the lens with a smug shameless face, mouth opening and closing in a confident talking rhythm. [2.4-3.6s] Shiba A raises its right front paw and points down at the basket. [3.6-6.0s] both dogs lean in, each picks up one drumstick treat in its mouth and chews happily, tails wagging. The treats keep exactly the same shape and golden-brown colour.

audio.emotion: 뜯겨 나간 통닭을 막 발견한 순간. 기가 막혀서 깊게 한숨 쉬고, 끝은 어이없어 떨리는 목소리. 화가 치밀어 오르기 직전.
버럭 소리친다. 언성을 확 높여 화가 폭발한 목소리, 끝을 세게 올려 다그친다.
강아지가 오히려 짖으며 대들자 황당해서 피식 웃음 섞인 기막힌 목소리. 눈을 가늘게 뜨고 비꼬듯이.
결정적 증거를 발견한 순간. 목소리를 확 낮추고 조용히, 한 박자 뜸 들인 뒤 또박또박. 승리한 듯한 낮은 톤.

audio.text: 사실 우리가 원한 건 뻑뻑한 통닭이 아니야!
audio.emotion: 들켰는데도 하나도 안 미안한 뻔뻔한 강아지. 당당하고 능청스럽게, 자신만만한 미소가 느껴지게. 끝은 힘주어 단언.
느끼하고 끈적한 광고 내레이션. 낮게 속삭이듯, 그러나 또렷하게.
